summary: Solver-visible Shopdesk HA core is a real, entrypoint-reachable dual-SQLite Django checkout plane with coupled fencing, AZ write affinity, sticky pins, seq-lag gates, capture effects, standby sync, and readiness composition. It fails large_system_strict Q6: systematic discard-touch `_ = (...)` wiring plus ~650 LOC of never-productively-called helpers inflate apparent scale, so honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is ~2,860 (excl. seed.sql/standby_seed.sql/generate_seed.py and theater), below the >=3,000 floor, with PADDING_RISK HIGH.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. For large_system_strict, >=3,000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient; Complexity Governor or authenticity-validator PASS is not enough.

Q6 method requires entrypoint tracing, reachability, distinct module responsibilities, clone/wrapper/padding checks, cross-module invariants, a ~25% removal test, and separating production logic from generated/config/data noise. PASS needs >=3,000 substantive reachable LOC and no HIGH toy/padding risk.

Count only implementation that materially participates in the claimed operational system. Dead/unreachable/unnecessary code and construction toward the 3,000-LOC floor via filler are authenticity defects. Seed volume is not authored runtime complexity.

Declares Software/Systems Django/SQLite failover checkout task with artifacts [/app/ha], separate verifier, public network, workdir /app/ha. Profile large_system_strict is confirmed by the design authenticity report, not by this file alone.
Design authenticity report records profile=large_system_strict. Used only to bind the strict LOC/padding gate; not treated as a copied complexity verdict.
Public HTTP entrypoints: /healthz, /readyz, place/pay/confirmation/order APIs wired to checkout and controlplane views.
Runtime config installs catalog/identity/inventory/checkout/fulfill/controlplane, dual DATABASES default/replica, ShopdeskRouter, and pins cache alias—real Django operator surface.
Operator workflow documents manage.py sync_standby/cutover/dump_failover, fence lease semantics, sticky pins, lag gates, and failover-status.json schema.
Cutover command reaches fencing + cutover_fsm + audit; includes discard-touch `_ = (plan, demoted_nodes(...))` that does not drive control flow.

ShopdeskRouter is DATABASE_ROUTERS-reachable and couples sticky pins, lag eligibility, and write_policy dispositions, but also discard-touches leftover_affinity_risk/split_brain_nodes/explain_write_path without using results.

Lease promote/writable_nodes/LSN bump are load-bearing for mutations, yet promote_standby/writable_nodes wrap describe_registry/demote_non_owners/snapshot_is_safe_for_traffic/role_for_lease in `_ = (...)` theater.

/readyz collects desk snapshot then discard-touches live_http_accepting and forces HTTP 200 via `ready_http_status(snap.live) if False else 200` with accepting_checkout hardcoded True—entrypoint exists, readiness composition is not honestly wired.

Place/pay/confirmation couple attempt validation, inventory reservation, fencing LSN, sticky pins, payment transitions, and fulfill capture effects—material multi-branch checkout logic, not a constant shell.

Aggregates writers, watermarks, pins, duplicate captures, alias health, and readiness inputs across controlplane/fulfill—real cross-component coupling—while still discard-touching describe_assessment/describe_probes/probe_codes.
Native SQLite schema for catalog/identity/inventory/checkout/fulfill/HA fence+watermark tables (~157 substantive lines). Counts as runtime/config structure; seed dumps do not.
Large deterministic seed (~20k checkout_order value tuples, multi-dimension variance). Evidence of stateful scale only; excluded from substantive runtime/config LOC per packet/profile instructions.
Offline seed generator; excluded from substantive runtime LOC per audit instructions.

M1 (py/json/schema.sql/start-lab, excl. seed.sql/standby_seed.sql/generate_seed.py/docs/logs/pin-cache, excl. `_=` theater blocks ~66 lines): ~3,510. M2 after also excluding never-productively-called function bodies (~650 lines, including discard-only helpers): ~2,860. Import closure from urls/wsgi/settings/manage.py commands reaches 58 Python modules; padding is mostly intra-module unused/discard-only helpers, not wholly unimported packages.

findings.criterion: Padding / false reachability must not inflate substantive LOC
findings.why_it_matters: Sixteen `_ = (...)` discard-touch blocks (~66 lines) call helpers (write_policy risk/split-brain, replica_plan sanitize, watermark describe/replica_read_allowed, pin survival checks, decide_claim, live_http_accepting, etc.) and throw away results. That manufactures import/call-graph reachability without changing starter behavior and is exactly the padding theater the strict gate excludes.
findings.minimal_remediation: Delete discard-touch statements and either wire those helpers into real control-flow/error decisions or remove the unused helper surfaces.
findings.regression_risk: Low if removals are unused; medium if a helper is later needed—prefer wiring over silent delete when the helper encodes a required invariant.

findings.criterion: large_system_strict requires >=3,000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC
findings.why_it_matters: Gross count excluding seeds/theater sits only slightly above 3,500. After removing never-productively-called helper bodies that do not change behavior, honest substantive reachable LOC is ~2,860—below the floor. Seed SQL and generate_seed.py must not close the gap.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add or deepen load-bearing reachable runtime/config logic so an honest post-padding inventory clears >=3,000 without counting seeds or discard-touch.
findings.regression_risk: Medium: naive LOC expansion can reintroduce padding; prefer wiring incomplete HA paths (readyz, lease sanitize, capture claim) over new dead modules.

findings.criterion: Major modules must contain material reachable branching, not unused filler
findings.why_it_matters: Static call analysis shows dozens of helpers that are never productively called or are only discard-touched (e.g. multiple write_policy descriptors, status_schema validate_status_object, ha_metrics probe helpers, pipeline stage-order helpers, reservation_ledger extras). Removing them would not change observed starter behavior—classic scale padding near the floor.
findings.minimal_remediation: Cull or productively integrate unused helpers; keep modules whose decisions actually gate writes/reads/readyz/capture.
findings.regression_risk: Low for pure dead code removal; verify oracle/NOP after integration of any helper that encodes a required invariant.

next_gate: Environment Builder removes discard-touch/dead-helper padding and raises honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC to >=3,000 with PADDING_RISK no higher than MEDIUM, then re-issue Q6 on the new task commit/scope hash. Quality Interlock cannot PASS on this REVISE.

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Independent inventory at 8dc0203f: excluding seed.sql/standby_seed.sql/generate_seed.py, docs/logs/pin-cache, and `_=` discard-touch theater (~66 lines), solver-visible py+json+schema.sql+start-lab ≈ 3,510 substantive lines. Import-reachable from urls/wsgi/settings/manage.py commands. After also excluding never-productively-called / discard-only helper bodies (~650 lines), honest substantive reachable runtime/config ≈ 2,860—below large_system_strict >=3,000. Core checkout/fencing/router/desk_state/fulfill paths are real; the miss is padding inflation, not absence of a domain system.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Pointing DATABASES['default'] at the intended writer without fencing/epoch demotion still leaves double-writable shop files.
Fixing ShopdeskRouter alone while AZ_WRITE_AFFINITY still diverts AZ-B mutations to replica leaves split placement.
Making /healthz green or forcing /readyz 200 without writer-count/seq-gap/pins/repeat-capture gates admits unsafe traffic.
Moving sticky keys without a shared pins store still loses read-your-writes across boxes after session wipe.
Idempotent pay path without unique capture effect per attempt_id still double-fires webhooks.
sync_standby that copies a writable fence lease recreates double-primary on standby.
Deleting discard-touch/dead helpers without adding productive reachable depth can leave the LOC floor unmet.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing core (router+fencing+sessions+lag, checkout place/pay, fulfill capture, desk_state/readiness composition, replica sync) would collapse the claimed HA/checkout behaviors and operator commands. Separately, removing the discard-touch blocks and never-productively-called helper bodies (~700 lines class) would not materially change current starter outcomes—evidence those lines are padding rather than production behavior.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Eliminate HIGH padding risk: remove `_ = (...)` discard-touch theater and cull or productively wire discard-only/unused helpers.
Raise honest substantive reachable runtime/config LOC to >=3,000 without counting seed.sql/standby_seed.sql/generate_seed.py or theater.
Prefer completing real control-flow for readiness/fencing/replica/capture invariants over adding new unused modules.
